{"notes": "Visit 4 (ended 6:00). Picture: one unbroken dark chain from START over the top, round the nose and along the bottom, now extending past the old end to about (17.2, 14.6). Nothing pale or disconnected. The crowded cluster near (11-13, 15) is real: two dashed paths overlap there, and the tail segment seems to start from the upper line's end (about 13, 14.9), not the lower one (13.5, 15.4). That may be the jam Leo flagged. It's connected now but could stall in the fall, so check it. I still can't see who placed which domino.

Leo: Consistent and proactive. He re-sequenced the handoff (Priya on the tail, Maya stands back), warned about the jammed overlap and the 'true end', and offered to check once Priya has moved on. This is good leadership and collaboration. His warning is about a risk I can see, so it's verified. Keep leadership at 4-5.

Maya: First words I've heard from her. At 5:30 she accepted the handoff clearly and said she'd check the belly joins. That supports Leo's claim that the bottom line was hers, but I haven't seen her place anything. The belly cluster is crowded, so see whether her join check finds or fixes it. Credit is still provisional.

Priya: Now has the tail, and the line did grow about 3.5 units, but I can't confirm she placed it. Check whether she left from the true end. The 1:45 contradiction on her top-line role still stands.

Tom: Silent again and not mentioned. No new evidence; still unclear what he contributed. Ask him directly.

Next: check the overlap, how the tail ends, whether the final fall runs through the whole chain, and who fixes any stall."}
